what: lite-loglogn RoaringSet direct-layout golden streams (PLAN-roaringset-G2 task 0, SPEC C-5 / C-6): G2-B2 replays them on PAGED sets; every field but byteLength (and dump `paged`, not stored) must match
cutFrom: LogLogN.js at 4d9c29a (frozen .handoff/frozen/LogLogN.4d9c29a-e0f18ff8.js, sha256/8 e0f18ff8), direct layout
ctor: new RoaringSet(U, maxS, maxL) -- the replay may append (maxPages, pageBits)
prng: mulberry32: s = (s + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0; t = s; t = imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1); t ^= t + imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61); return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 2^32; s starts at seed >>> 0
opMix: first HN = min(C, 96) draws: hot chunks H[j] = floor(r() * C), C = ceil(U / 65536). Op n (1-based): n === 10000 -> clear; else n % 2500 === 0 -> runOptimize; else a burst in progress -> add(burstKey), burstKey = (burstKey + step) % U; else t = r(): t < 0.0015 starts a 1024-add burst: b = HN > 1 && r() < 0.5 ? 1 : 0 (r() drawn only when HN > 1), step = 2 - b, first key (H[b] * 65536 + floor(r() * 65536)) % U (this op is its first add); < 0.45 add(key()); < 0.60 delete(key()); < 0.72 has(key()); < 0.84 successor(key()); < 0.96 predecessor(key()); < 0.98 min(); else max(). key(): r() < 0.03 -> floor(r() * U); else j = floor(r() * HN), (H[j] * 65536 + floor(r() * W[j & 3])) % U with W = [65536, 8192, 1024, 128]. A scheduled op draws nothing.
cadence: runOptimize at n = 2500, 5000, 7500, 12500, 15000, 17500, 20000; clear at n = 10000; dump BEFORE ops 5000 / 10000 / 15000 / 20000 and after the last op (`before: "end"`); sizes[k] = size after op 500 (k + 1)
opsText: opsSha = sha256/8 of the ops joined as "<code>:<key>" with "," (codes 0 add, 1 delete, 2 has, 3 successor, 4 predecessor, 5 min, 6 max, 7 runOptimize, 8 clear; key -1 for keyless ops)
res: one token per op, joined with ",": add "+" (size + 1) / "=" (already present); delete / has "t" / "f"; successor / predecessor / min / max the key in decimal or "u" (undefined); runOptimize "o" (returned this); clear "c"; any throw "E<k>" with throws[k] = "<name>: <message>" (first-seen order). resSha = sha256/8 of res
dumps: dump() as { size, chunks: [[chunk, kind name, count, runs], ...] } (universe and paged omitted)

streams.name: U=2^32
throws: RangeError: [lite-loglogn] RoaringSet large container pool exhausted (capacity 32); increase pool capacity at construction
